scope: Same production binary, fresh processes, warm filesystem. Default runtime settings, explicit checker count only. Four balanced rounds after one warmup/count. Exploratory scaling, not an adoption gate or native comparison. GNU time CPU precision is 0.01 seconds; wrapper-inclusive wall uses monotonic nanoseconds. RSS is command peak, not aggregate tree peak. No allocation counts measured.
